summary: Bread Financial Holdings filed an 8-K on September 3, 2026 disclosing Amendment No. 2 to its June 7, 2023 Credit Agreement with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. as administrative agent. The amendment permits the previously announced merger of Comenity Bank into Comenity Capital Bank, with Comenity Capital Bank surviving, as an exception to Revolving Credit Facility covenants. All regulatory approvals were received July 31, 2026; consummation is expected on or around October 1, 2026, subject to waiting periods and customary conditions. The $700 million senior unsecured revolving facility terms remain otherwise unchanged. This is an internal bank charter consolidation, not a special situation; watch remaining closing conditions, not risk-arb.
